info.title: OpenState API
info.description: OpenState — Enterprise Conversation State Orchestration Platform API.

tags.name: System
tags.description: Baseline system endpoints for OpenState health and app info.

tags.name: Admin Console
tags.description: Tenant-scoped administration, runtime operations, and read-only event browsing.

get.description: Returns only the tenant selected by the authenticated request context. Requires tenant:read.

patch.description: Updates the authenticated tenant profile and records an audit entry. Requires tenant:update.

get.description: Returns a paginated, searchable membership list constrained to the authenticated tenant. Requires user:read.

put.description: Validates the tenant role and rejects changes that would remove the last Owner. Requires user:update.

delete.description: Removes only the membership in the authenticated tenant and preserves at least one Owner. Requires user:delete.

get.description: Returns runtime instances for the authenticated tenant. Requires instance:read.

post.description: Validates the current lifecycle state and optimistic version before suspending. Requires instance:suspend.
Validates that the instance is suspended before resuming. Requires instance:resume.
Retries the current failed state using optimistic concurrency and leaves event history immutable. Requires instance:retry.

get.description: Returns immutable, paginated event history with safe tenant-scoped filters. No event mutation or replay operation is exposed. Requires instance:read.
Returns a single immutable event scoped to the authenticated tenant. Requires instance:read.
Lists non-secret machine credential metadata for the tenant selected by X-Tenant-ID. Requires api_key:read.

post.summary: Create a State MCP API key
post.description: Creates a tenant-scoped key. The raw key is returned exactly once in this response and cannot be retrieved later. Requires api_key:create.

post.summary: Revoke a State MCP API key
post.description: Revokes an active tenant-owned key. The key is denied on every subsequent State MCP request. Requires api_key:revoke.

get.description: Returns a filtered, paginated view of the tenant-scoped audit trail (PRD 50), ordered newest first. Requires the audit:read permission.
Returns the tenant-scoped capability registry, optionally filtered by provider type and status.

post.description: Registers a capability scoped to the tenant. Secrets are never accepted or returned; only credential_reference.

get.description: Returns a single tenant-scoped capability.

patch.description: Updates mutable fields of a tenant-scoped capability.

delete.description: Disables (removes) a tenant-scoped capability and its bindings.

get.description: Returns the tenant-scoped bindings of a capability.

post.description: Binds a capability to a tenant/workflow/state scope with an allow/deny permission.
Runs a capability through the security chain in mock/sandbox mode and returns the normalized result. Never triggers live external side effects.

get.description: Returns the published intent mappings for the requested project. When projectId is omitted, the tenant's existing Default Project is used. Requires workflow:read.

parameters.name: projectId
parameters.description: Optional project scope; defaults to the tenant's existing Default Project

get.description: Lists external MCP connections owned by the selected project. Credentials and protected references are never returned.

post.description: Establishes an MCP session only. It does not call tools/list or provider business tools.

post.summary: Run a safe MCP connection diagnostic
post.description: Runs the bounded handshake test and updates safe health metadata. It never returns credentials or provider payloads.
Clears circuit and failure counters without changing credentials or connection configuration.
Stores a replacement bearer credential in the configured secret store and revokes the previous reference. The value is write-only.
Revokes the protected secret and removes its connection reference. Subsequent gateway calls fail closed until a new credential is configured.

get.description: Returns lifecycle status only. Secret values and protected references are never returned.

post.description: Creates a short-lived state and PKCE transaction. Only the authorization URL and safe lifecycle metadata are returned.

get.description: Validates one-time state and PKCE, exchanges the authorization code server-side, and persists protected token references.

post.description: Revokes locally stored token artifacts and clears their references without returning token material.

get.description: Returns OAuth lifecycle status and expiry only; token artifacts and references are never returned.

get.summary: List the stored MCP tool catalog
get.description: Returns the latest sanitized tools/list catalog and discovery-run status. This endpoint reads stored metadata and never contacts or invokes the provider.

post.description: Explicitly initializes the registered MCP connection and requests tools/list. It never calls a provider business tool. A failed refresh preserves the previous successful catalog.

patch.summary: Enable or disable a discovered MCP tool
patch.description: Updates local eligibility only. It does not call the provider and does not rewrite workflow bindings.

get.summary: List eligible project MCP tool options
get.description: Returns only enabled connections and present, enabled discovered tools. Endpoints, credentials, and arbitrary tool names are never returned.
Returns active, unavailable, and explicit MISSING_MAPPING health for logical MCP capabilities in the project.

put.summary: Bind a logical capability to a discovered MCP tool
put.description: Accepts only project-scoped connection and discovered-tool IDs. The target must be enabled, present, and owned by the same project.

delete.summary: Remove a project MCP capability binding

get.description: Returns projects owned by the tenant selected by X-Tenant-ID. This read-only endpoint supplies project choices for the Admin Console flow and State MCP API-key creation and requires workflow:read.
Returns tenant-scoped persisted workflow instances. Requires instance:read.
Returns the tenant-scoped workflow/version, state, sanitized context, timeline, and audit correlations. Requires instance:read.
Returns only OpenState-owned sanitized trace metadata. It never calls an LLM, RAG, MCP provider, or OTLP collector. Requires debug:read.
Returns baseline information about the OpenState API.
Returns a simple health check payload for the OpenState API.
Returns the tenant-scoped workflow definitions within a project (defaults to the tenant's default project).

post.description: Creates a workflow definition draft (status=DRAFT) with its complete editable graph scoped to the tenant.

Runs an unsaved workflow snapshot in an isolated deterministic sandbox. Capability requests are mock plans only; no runtime instance, event, audit record, LLM, MCP, or live provider is created or invoked (PRD §53).

get.description: Returns a single tenant/project-scoped workflow definition.

patch.description: Atomically replaces an editable workflow's metadata and complete graph at an expected optimistic version (PRD §31).

post.description: Validates the persisted workflow draft and publishes it as an immutable, current version (PRD §3.3, §9, §55, §65, §69).

get.description: Returns the immutable versions of a workflow, newest first.

key.description: Raw secret shown only in this response.

providerTool.description: Concrete provider MCP tool name; providerId is a server alias.

credentialReference.description: Reference to a stored credential. Secret values are NEVER returned.

scopeId.description: Optional workflow/state scope for binding resolution

fromMock.description: True when executed via the mock/sandbox provider

key.description: Canonical intent key used for routing

stdioProfile.description: Required for stdio; must be a trusted deployment profile.

credentialReference.description: Legacy opaque secret-manager reference. Never a raw token and never returned.

credentialValue.description: Bearer credential value. Stored immediately in the configured secret store and never returned.

oauthAuthorizationEndpoint.description: HTTPS authorization endpoint for OAuth connections.

oauthTokenEndpoint.description: HTTPS token endpoint for OAuth connections.

projectId.description: Optional; defaults to the tenant's default project

initialContext.description: Optional context available before the first event
